1 # Yoh 1.12-13; 16.3 Monhwɛ ɔdɔ ko a Agya no de adɔ yɛn, sɛ wɔmfrɛ yɛn Nyankopɔn mma, na yɛyɛ nso. Yei nti wiase nhu yɛn, ɛfiri sɛ ɛnhunuu no. 2#Rom 8.17; Kol 3.4 Adɔfo, afei yɛyɛ Nyankopɔn mma, na deɛ yɛbɛyɛ no nnya nnaa adi. Na yɛnim sɛ, sɛ ɔyi ne ho adi a, yɛbɛyɛ sɛ ɔno, ɛfiri sɛ yɛbɛhu no sɛdeɛ ɔteɛ. 3#Yes 53.4-5; 53.9; 1 Pe 2.24 Na obiara a ɔwɔ ne ho anidasoɔ yi no, ɔte ne ho sɛdeɛ ɔno ho teɛ.
4Obiara a ɔyɛ bɔne no, ɔyɛ de to mmara, na bɔne ne mmarato. 5#Yes 53.4-5; 53.9; 1 Pe 2.24 Na monim sɛ ɔno deɛ, ɔyii ne ho adi sɛ ɔrebɛyi bɔne akɔ, na bɔne nni ne mu. 6#Rom 6.14 Obiara a ɔte ne mu no nyɛ bɔne. Obiara a ɔyɛ bɔne no nhunuu no, nanso ɔnnim no.
7 # 1 Yoh 2.29 Mma nkumaa, mommma obiara nnnaadaa mo. Deɛ ɔyɛ deɛ ɛtene no, ɔtene sɛdeɛ ɔno nso tene. 8#Yoh 8.44 Deɛ ɔyɛ bɔne no firi ɔbonsam, ɛfiri sɛ ɔbonsam na ɔfiri mfitiaseɛ yɛɛ bɔne. Yei nti na Nyankopɔn Ba no bɛyii ne ho adi sɛ ɔbɛsɛe ɔbonsam nnwuma.
9 # 1 Yoh 3.6; 5.18 Obiara a Onyankopɔn awo no no nyɛ bɔne, ɛfiri sɛ ne su te ne mu, na ɔntumi nyɛ bɔne, ɛfiri sɛ Onyankopɔn na wawo no. 10Yei mu na Nyankopɔn mma ne ɔbonsam mma da adie. Obiara a ɔnyɛ deɛ ɛtene ne deɛ ɔnnɔ ne nua no mfiri Onyankopɔn.
Monnodɔ mo ho
11 # Yoh 13.34 Na yei ne kaseɛ a moate firi mfitiaseɛ sɛ yɛnnodɔ yɛn ho no, 12#Gye 4.8 ɛnyɛ sɛ Kain a ɔfiri bɔne mu na ɔkumm ne nua no. Na adɛn nti na ɔkumm no? Ɛfiri sɛ ɔno ara ne nnwuma yɛ bɔne, na ne nua deɛ no deɛ, ɛtene.
13 # Mat 5.11; Yoh 15.18-19 Anuanom, wiase tan mo a, mommma no nnyɛ mo nwanwa. 14#Yoh 5.24; 1 Yoh 2.11 Yɛn deɛ, yɛnim sɛ yɛatwa mu afiri owuo mu akɔ nkwa mu, ɛfiri sɛ yɛdɔ anuanom. Deɛ ɔnni dɔ no te owuo mu. 15#Mat 5.21-22 Obiara a ɔtan ne nua no yɛ owudini; na monim sɛ daa nkwa rentena owudini biara mu.
16 # Yoh 15.13 Yei mu na yɛahunu ɔdɔ no, sɛ ɔno de ne nkwa too hɔ maa yɛn. Na ɛsɛ yɛn nso sɛ yɛde yɛn nkwa to hɔ ma anuanom. 17#Deut 15.7; 1 Yoh 4.20 Na deɛ ɔwɔ wiase asetenadeɛ, na ɔhunu ne nua sɛ ahia no, na ɔbɔ no ayamuɔnwono no, Nyankopɔn dɔ no te ne mu sɛn? 18#Yak 1.22; 2.15-16 Me mma nkumaa, mommma yɛmmfa asɛm anaa tɛkyerɛma nnɔ, na mmom momma yɛnnɔ nneyɛɛ ne nokorɛ mu. 19Na yei mu na yɛbɛhunu sɛ yɛfiri nokorɛ no mu, na yɛbɛdwodwo yɛn akoma wɔ n’anim sɛ, 20sɛ yɛn akoma bu yɛn fɔ a, Onyankopɔn so kyɛne yɛn akoma na ɔhunu ade nyinaa. 21#Rom 5.1-2; Heb 4.16 Adɔfo, sɛ yɛn akoma mmu yɛn fɔ a, ɛnneɛ yɛde nnam kɔ Nyankopɔn anim, 22#Mar 11.24 na biribiara a yɛsrɛ no, yɛnya firi ne nkyɛn, ɛfiri sɛ yɛdi n’ahyɛdeɛ so, na yɛyɛ deɛ ɛsɔ n’ani. 23#Yoh 6.29; 15.17 Na yei ne n’ahyɛdeɛ, sɛ yɛnnye ne Ba Yesu Kristo din no nni, na yɛnnodɔ yɛn ho, sɛdeɛ ɔmaa yɛn ahyɛdeɛ no. 24#1 Yoh 4.13; Rom 8.9 Na deɛ ɔdi n’ahyɛdeɛ soɔ no te ne mu, na ɔno nso te ne mu. Na deɛ yɛde hunu sɛ ɔte yɛn mu ne honhom a ɔde ama yɛn no.

pageProps.chapterText:
Monhwɛ ɔdɔ ko a Agya no de adɔ yɛn, sɛ wɔmfrɛ yɛn Nyankopɔn mma, na yɛyɛ nso. Yei nti wiase nhu yɛn, ɛfiri sɛ ɛnhunuu no. Adɔfo, afei yɛyɛ Nyankopɔn mma, na deɛ yɛbɛyɛ no nnya nnaa adi. Na yɛnim sɛ, sɛ ɔyi ne ho adi a, yɛbɛyɛ sɛ ɔno, ɛfiri sɛ yɛbɛhu no sɛdeɛ ɔteɛ. Na obiara a ɔwɔ ne ho anidasoɔ yi no, ɔte ne ho sɛdeɛ ɔno ho teɛ.
Obiara a ɔyɛ bɔne no, ɔyɛ de to mmara, na bɔne ne mmarato. Na monim sɛ ɔno deɛ, ɔyii ne ho adi sɛ ɔrebɛyi bɔne akɔ, na bɔne nni ne mu. Obiara a ɔte ne mu no nyɛ bɔne. Obiara a ɔyɛ bɔne no nhunuu no, nanso ɔnnim no.
Mma nkumaa, mommma obiara nnnaadaa mo. Deɛ ɔyɛ deɛ ɛtene no, ɔtene sɛdeɛ ɔno nso tene. Deɛ ɔyɛ bɔne no firi ɔbonsam, ɛfiri sɛ ɔbonsam na ɔfiri mfitiaseɛ yɛɛ bɔne. Yei nti na Nyankopɔn Ba no bɛyii ne ho adi sɛ ɔbɛsɛe ɔbonsam nnwuma.
Obiara a Onyankopɔn awo no no nyɛ bɔne, ɛfiri sɛ ne su te ne mu, na ɔntumi nyɛ bɔne, ɛfiri sɛ Onyankopɔn na wawo no. Yei mu na Nyankopɔn mma ne ɔbonsam mma da adie. Obiara a ɔnyɛ deɛ ɛtene ne deɛ ɔnnɔ ne nua no mfiri Onyankopɔn.

Na yei ne kaseɛ a moate firi mfitiaseɛ sɛ yɛnnodɔ yɛn ho no, ɛnyɛ sɛ Kain a ɔfiri bɔne mu na ɔkumm ne nua no. Na adɛn nti na ɔkumm no? Ɛfiri sɛ ɔno ara ne nnwuma yɛ bɔne, na ne nua deɛ no deɛ, ɛtene.
Anuanom, wiase tan mo a, mommma no nnyɛ mo nwanwa. Yɛn deɛ, yɛnim sɛ yɛatwa mu afiri owuo mu akɔ nkwa mu, ɛfiri sɛ yɛdɔ anuanom. Deɛ ɔnni dɔ no te owuo mu. Obiara a ɔtan ne nua no yɛ owudini; na monim sɛ daa nkwa rentena owudini biara mu.
Yei mu na yɛahunu ɔdɔ no, sɛ ɔno de ne nkwa too hɔ maa yɛn. Na ɛsɛ yɛn nso sɛ yɛde yɛn nkwa to hɔ ma anuanom. Na deɛ ɔwɔ wiase asetenadeɛ, na ɔhunu ne nua sɛ ahia no, na ɔbɔ no ayamuɔnwono no, Nyankopɔn dɔ no te ne mu sɛn? Me mma nkumaa, mommma yɛmmfa asɛm anaa tɛkyerɛma nnɔ, na mmom momma yɛnnɔ nneyɛɛ ne nokorɛ mu. Na yei mu na yɛbɛhunu sɛ yɛfiri nokorɛ no mu, na yɛbɛdwodwo yɛn akoma wɔ n’anim sɛ, sɛ yɛn akoma bu yɛn fɔ a, Onyankopɔn so kyɛne yɛn akoma na ɔhunu ade nyinaa. Adɔfo, sɛ yɛn akoma mmu yɛn fɔ a, ɛnneɛ yɛde nnam kɔ Nyankopɔn anim, na biribiara a yɛsrɛ no, yɛnya firi ne nkyɛn, ɛfiri sɛ yɛdi n’ahyɛdeɛ so, na yɛyɛ deɛ ɛsɔ n’ani. Na yei ne n’ahyɛdeɛ, sɛ yɛnnye ne Ba Yesu Kristo din no nni, na yɛnnodɔ yɛn ho, sɛdeɛ ɔmaa yɛn ahyɛdeɛ no. Na deɛ ɔdi n’ahyɛdeɛ soɔ no te ne mu, na ɔno nso te ne mu. Na deɛ yɛde hunu sɛ ɔte yɛn mu ne honhom a ɔde ama yɛn no.

app.t1_copy: I've bookmarked passages that are important to me. I've even read the whole thing through in a year thanks to the reading plans.
app.t2_copy: I love how you are able to connect with friends and the Bible reading plans are awesome. This application helps me also to stay consistent in reading because it has reminders for the plans. It also gives me another way to come closer to God. Download this and read every day!
app.t3_copy: Great app with a wide selection of Bibles to choose from. ... The audio Bibles are also wonderful and easy to understand.
app.t4_copy: Many translations and languages available, and many that can be downloaded to read offline. Many useful features, such as the ability to make notes and bookmarks.
app.t5_copy: I love how it has a lot of versions and that there are verses of the day, devotions, plans and community. Thanks for this free app. :)
app.t6_copy: Great because there are many different versions and I could download multiple versions for offline reading. I'm able to listen to this app.
app.t7_copy: Helps me to read the bible more. Love the search and share features and the variety of ways to share. Also like the audio versions.
app.t8_copy: This is a great tool for studying from multiple translations. It's also convenient for listening to the bible when you're driving.
app.t9_copy: This is the best bible app out there. It has the word in different languages and versions for online and offline use. It has devotionals for everything you could think of. You can connect with others and ultimately learn about God and his Word.
